title: Tennessee TE Ethan Davis lost for season with ACL injury
dek: Tennessee senior tight end Ethan Davis suffered an ACL injury and will miss the remainder of the 2026 season, head coach Josh Heupel announced on September 14. Davis had caught touchdown passes in each of the first two games before the injury.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Senior tight end Ethan Davis is out for the 2026 season with an ACL injury, confirmed by head coach Josh Heupel on September 14.
bottom_line: Davis' loss removes a red-zone target in the early stages of SEC play. Brame and Thomas' performance in the next two games against Kennesaw State and beyond will indicate whether Tennessee can maintain offensive balance without its primary tight end.
body: Tennessee senior tight end Ethan Davis suffered an ACL injury and will be out for the remainder of the 2026 season, head coach Josh Heupel announced on September 14. Heupel said during his weekly press conference: "Ethan Davis (with) an ACL injury will be gone for the remainder of the year."

Davis had a strong start to the campaign, catching touchdown passes in each of the first two games before the injury. Through the early season, Davis had three catches for 43 yards. Tennessee defeated Georgia Tech 45-24 in the game where Davis was injured.

Sophomore DaSaahn Brame and South Alabama transfer Trent Thomas will pick up more load at tight end moving forward. No. 14 Tennessee (2-0) plays Kennesaw State (1-1) on September 19 at 7:45 p.m. ET on SEC Network at Neyland Stadium.
